title: CC-CV Charging (Proportional Control)
text: Constant-current constant-voltage charging algorithm with proportional control, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify CellVoltage input as [Min,Max]} sets the option to specify CellVoltage input as minimum and maximum and {Controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of controller. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ChargingEnabled
ports.summary: Whether to enable battery charging boolean

ports.name: CellVoltage
ports.summary: Voltage of cells, V scalar | vector

ports.name: ChargeCurrentLimit
ports.summary: Limit of charging current, A scalar

params.name: Specify CellVoltage input as [Min,Max]
params.values: Option to specify CellVoltage input as minimum and maximum values off (default) | on
